items.title: BadHost 漏洞使 AI 代理、评估器和 LLM 网关面临风险
items.raw_excerpt: BadHost 是广泛使用的 Python Web 框架 Starlette 中一个高危的身份验证绕过漏洞。该框架每周的下载量达 3.25 亿次。该漏洞允许攻击者利用格式错误的 HTTP Host 头绕过基于路径的访问控制，从而访问敏感的 AI 代理基础设施及其他系统。

title_i18n.zh: BadHost 漏洞使 AI 代理、评估器和 LLM 网关面临风险
title_i18n.en: BadHost vulnerability puts AI agents, evaluators, and LLM gateways at risk.
title_i18n.es: La vulnerabilidad BadHost pone en riesgo a los agentes de IA, evaluadores y puertas de enlace de LLM.

excerpt_i18n.zh: BadHost 是广泛使用的 Python Web 框架 Starlette 中一个高危的身份验证绕过漏洞。该框架每周的下载量达 3.25 亿次。该漏洞允许攻击者利用格式错误的 HTTP Host 头绕过基于路径的访问控制，从而访问敏感的 AI 代理基础设施及其他系统。
excerpt_i18n.en: BadHost is a high-severity authentication bypass vulnerability in Starlette, a widely used Python web framework with 325 million weekly downloads. The flaw allows attackers to bypass path-based access controls using malformed HTTP Host headers, thereby gaining access to sensitive AI agent infrastructure and other systems.
excerpt_i18n.es: BadHost es una vulnerabilidad de alto riesgo de omisión de autenticación en Starlette, un framework web de Python ampliamente utilizado. Este framework se descarga 325 millones de veces por semana. La vulnerabilidad permite a los atacantes eludir los controles de acceso basados en rutas mediante cabeceras HTTP Host malformadas, accediendo así a infraestructuras sensibles de agentes de IA y otros sistemas.

Addressing this high-density knowledge scenario, Zhiyuan will officially launch a personal exclusive intelligent agent, SoulAgent, offering attendees a brand-new intelligent conference experience.

SoulAgent is not just a one-time Q&A tool but an AI companion that continuously grows through long-term interaction, becoming more attuned to users over time. During this Zhiyuan Conference, SoulAgent will accompany attendees throughout, supporting synchronized listening across multiple venues, helping users track content from various forums in real time, and recording, summarizing, and extracting key insights. Additionally, SoulAgent will integrate avatars of 11 top AI experts, enabling users to engage in multi-round dialogues on cutting-edge ideas, research directions, and technical issues, transforming frontier exchanges from one-way listening into two-way interaction.

During this Zhiyuan Conference, 25 forums and special events will be held intensively. items.title: ICRA 2026最佳论文奖，千寻智能首席科学家、清华高阳团队FP3入围
items.raw_excerpt: 原文作者：谭梓馨 原文链接：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/llcXE2be4oNWItL_0ydVZw 2026年IEEE国际机器人与自动化会议（IEEE ICRA 2026）是机器人与自动化领域的顶级学术盛会，于6月1日至5日在奥地利维也纳举办。 今年，FP3、HITTER等多篇华人团队论文入围最佳论文奖提名，头部科技此前曾报道过 HITTER ，今天来看另一篇研究FP3。 FP3论文的导师之一高阳是清华大学跨学科信息科学研究院（IIIS）的助理教授，同时他也是国内具身独角兽千寻智能（Spirit AI）的联创兼首席科学家。 下面，一起来看看FP3做了哪些创新工作。 三维基座带来的改进 基于海量多任务数据预训练的基座大模型在机器人领域展现出巨大潜力，但绝大多数机器人基础策略模型仅采用二维图像作为输入观测，缺失三维几何信息，而三维几何是机器人感知、理解真实三维空间的关键。 概括来说，FP3是一个面向机器人操作的大规模三维基座策略模型。 该模型参数大小为1.3B，基于可规模化的扩散Transformer架构搭建，依托6万条含点云观测的运动轨迹完成预训练，凭借特有模型结构与多元化预训练数据，FP3可快速微调适配各类下游任务，泛化性能优异。 真机实测表明：仅需80组人工示教样本，FP3即可在包含全新未知物体的陌生场景中习得新任务，性能大幅领先现有机器人基座模型。 在自建的多项新任务数据集上验证FP3高效微调与强泛化特性，结果显示：仅使用单卡、两小时微调，相较主流基线，同场景性能平均提升60%，开放未知场景性能平均提升80%。 性能对比表现突出 FP3的在架构中设计了一个编码器-解码器扩散Transformer网络，首先对多模态输入进行编码，包括3D点云、语言和机器人本体感受状态，然后对动作进行去噪。 研究人员与业内其他机器人控制策略进行了对比，域内实验结果

Original Author: Tan Zixin  
Original Link: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/llcXE2be4oNWItL_0ydVZw  
The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (IEEE ICRA 2026), a top-tier academic event in robotics and automation, will be held from June 1 to 5 in Vienna, Austria. This year, several papers from Chinese teams, including FP3 and HITTER, have been nominated for Best Paper Awards. Leading Tech previously reported on HITTER; today, we look at another study, FP3.  
One of FP3's paper advisors, Gao Yang, is an assistant professor at Tsinghua University's Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS) and also a co-founder and chief scientist of the domestic embodied intelligence unicorn Spirit AI.  
Below, let's explore the innovations of FP3.  
Improvements from a 3D Foundation  
Foundation models pre-trained on massive multi-task data show great potential in robotics, but most basic robot policy models only use 2D images as input observations, lacking 3D geometric information—crucial for robots to perceive and understand real 3D space.  
In summary, FP3 is a large-scale 3D foundation policy model for robotic manipulation.  
With 1.3B parameters, it is built on a scalable diffusion Transformer architecture, pre-trained on 60,000 motion trajectories with point cloud observations, leveraging its unique modality.

items.title: 智能戒指爆发前夜，RingConn走到哪一步了？
items.raw_excerpt: 作者 | 吴优 编辑 | 刘伟 “智能戒指在世界上依然是一个小众市场，年销量几百万枚，但我相信它在未来一定会跟上智能手表的步伐，实现全球上亿只的销量”。作为上海交通大学特聘教授及RingConn品牌创始人的王国兴教授，5月30日在深圳 INNO100 全球创新旗舰店内发表了对智能戒指未来的看法。 这天是 RingConn Gen3 的产品发布会，王国兴教授着装浅绿衬衫，手戴三枚智能戒指出席了本次活动，向到场的科技爱好者和用户们介绍新一代AI智能戒指产品。 与 Gen 2 相比，Gen 3 的核心亮点集中在三个方面： 其一， 长期血压趋势洞察，依托临床验证实现每 15 分钟自动监测，呈现用户真实血管负荷；同时基于睡眠、运动、昼夜节律、全天血管稳定度的负荷因子综合分析，给到全面血管健康分析与个性化改善； 其二，行业首创微觉醒识别，能够捕捉睡眠中用户不自知的短暂苏醒，更真实反映疲劳度与睡眠质量； 其三，新增 AI 健康震动提醒，支持心率异常、久坐、压力过高、头痛、发热、脱水等多场景主动干预。 与此同时，Gen3 搭载 7 个传感器平行堆叠架构与 VCSEL 红外方案，采用内圆外方专利人体工学与航空级钛合金材质，在功能大幅增强的前提下，续航最高可达 14 天，搭配充电仓使用长达 150 天，实现监测精度、佩戴舒适度与续航能力的全面平衡。 Gen 3 定价2599-2799人民币，本代产品依旧不收软件订阅费。 雷峰网·鲸犀在此次发布会后与王国兴教授进行了一次对话，聊了聊 Gen 3 的技术实现与 RingConn 过去几年的发展以及对智能戒指的未来判断。 雷峰网·鲸犀： Gen3 主打血管健康，血管健康包括血氧、血压与心率三个维度的监测。您发布会上提到指尖测血氧比腕部更准确，很多普通用户对此认知不深，能不能从原理和数据上解释下这一结论的科学性？ 王国兴： 从原理上来拆解，测血氧的核心

Author | Wu You    Editor | Liu Wei  

"Smart rings are still a niche market globally, with annual sales of a few million units, but I believe they will eventually catch up with smartwatches and achieve global sales of hundreds of millions." Professor Wang Guoxing, a distinguished professor at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and founder of the RingConn brand, shared his outlook on the future of smart rings on May 30 at the INNO100 Global Innovation Flagship Store in Shenzhen.  

That day marked the product launch of the RingConn Gen3. Professor Wang, dressed in a light green shirt and wearing three smart rings, attended the event to introduce the new-generation AI smart ring to tech enthusiasts and users.  

Compared to the Gen2, the Gen3 focuses on three key upgrades:  

First, long-term blood pressure trend insights, enabled by clinically validated automatic monitoring every 15 minutes to reflect real vascular load. It also provides comprehensive vascular health analysis and personalized improvements based on load factors such as sleep, exercise, circadian rhythm, and daily vascular stability.  

Second, the industry's first micro-awakening recognition, capable of detecting brief, unnoticed awakenings during sleep, offering a more accurate reflection of fatigue and sleep quality.  

Third, the addition of AI-powered health vibration alerts, supporting proactive interventions in scenarios such as abnormal heart rate, prolonged sitting, high stress, headaches, fever, and dehydration.  

Additionally, the Gen3 features a parallel stacked architecture with seven sensors and a VCSEL infrared solution, utilizing a patented ergonomic design with a round inner structure and square outer shape.

items.title: CVPR 2026 | 支撑春晚合肥 7 分钟的4K画面奇观  PS-SR让视频超分不用在速度与质量间为难

Few know that the technical core supporting these 4K-level visuals comes from the PS-SR framework proposed by the Zhixiang Future team—a "Pseudo-Single-Step" video super-resolution framework. This breakthrough work has been accepted by CVPR 2026, a top-tier conference in computer vision. Turning boundless creativity into broadcast-ready Spring Festival Gala footage requires not only efficiently processing massive amounts of live-action and generated material in 4K quality but, more critically, ensuring that every frame at 60 fps withstands second-by-second scrutiny.
